metadata.description: Layer f: FD spectra (spectrum_levels(1)) for cc and cs under one-at-a-time parameter/mass/SpinTerms variations
metadata.float_format: shortest round-trip repr of IEEE-754 double (exact when parsed as float64); non-finite -> null
metadata.units: masses/energies GeV, r GeV^-1, p GeV

notes.runs: one parameter changed at a time relative to the default parameter file; parameters/masses/terms store the full set used
notes.masses: m_c/m_s variations use Meson(flavor1, flavor2, ConstituentMasses(...)); the other masses are the defaults
notes.levels: spectrum_levels(1) = 1S,1P,1D multiplets unless levels_spec says otherwise
